create_video_visualizer: create a VideoVisualizer instance to visualize video classification predictions with configurable thresholds and top-k modes
draw_clip_visualization: draw a video clip with fading bounding boxes and class labels centered around a keyframe
draw_clip_range_visualization: draw a subset of frames from a video clip with fading visualizations within a specified frame range
draw_frame_predictions: draw predicted class labels and bounding boxes on a single video frame with configurable transparency
create_text_labels: create formatted text labels for video classification predictions with scores and class names
